# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE4_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-23

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that tightening the stop loss to 35% of premium and increasing the take-profit target to 75% of premium will improve risk-adjusted returns by capturing more of the winners' upside while limiting losses on adverse moves, based on the grinder's edge_capture of 506.55.

## Mechanism

Enter on the base strategy signal (likely BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON or similar trigger from shotgun_scalper_stage3). Exit when:  
- Premium reaches +75% of entry (TP1)  
- Premium drops to -35% of entry (stop)  
- Time stop at 12 minutes  
No scaling out or profit-lock; all-or-nothing exit at TP1 or stop.
